Hey. Little helpful tip for everyone in the comments! 
Open your map and look for a ship thats on water east of the mountain of frozen souls location in the map. You can find a small boat on the beach you can use to paddle to the ship. there are some mines you have to go around first before you can get on. I don't remember which door inside but make sure you kill ever pirate and search every room. In one of the rooms you will find the pirate hat. It gives you a buff that helps you find treasure chests
